description: Spec 029 ① (Art. VII): provenance that no longer matches the Aspekto. A value names a token its set does not define; the value written in the set is no longer the one the provenance records (radius.medium is 10 px, the record says 12 px); an adapted value names no Jugxo, another one a Jugxo that does not exist. The last value is in order.
